title: bug: JetBrains protected PATH filter keeps entries as written, so an edge-quoted or space-padded entry escapes the project check
description:
MoeDaemonSupervisor.protectedPathEntries validates unquoted(entry) (trim plus surrounding ") but keeps the as-written entry.
- Windows: libuv's PATH search strips one leading or trailing ' or ". Verified on node v24.16.0: PATH=C:\Windows\System32' still runs whoami. So `<project>'` passes isOutsideProject (realpath ENOENT, and the normalized form differs from the project), and the daemon's bare-name spawns then search the project.
- POSIX: ` /x` survives as a relative execvp entry.
VS Code fixed this in RF06b reopen 1 (task-032c973941bc41d9b051eedacb7de0b6): keep the validated spelling and drop entries ending in a quote.
definitionOfDone: JetBrains protectedPathEntries/protectedDaemonEnvironment keep only validated spellings (trimmed, surrounding quotes removed) and drop any entry that still starts or ends with ' or ". A test shows `<project>'` dropped and a space-padded outside entry kept unpadded.
